0022600175.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, 13th in the East, on a two-game losing streak, 0-2 on the road) visit the Boston Celtics (5-1, 3rd in the East, on a five-game winning streak, 4-0 at home) in a regular season game, with Milwaukee sitting 4.5 games back of the Central lead. Boston will be without Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest), both listed as out. The teams have no 2026-27 series games yet, while the Bucks lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 133-101 loss in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
